title: Great day in Barcelona
text: The driver and guide (Martina) were both very helpful and knowledgeable to the area. Our wheelchair bound friend was treated caringly and never felt excluded or as if he slowed us down. He was able to see everything and experience all. Martina was very kind and extremely knowledgeable. It was evident that she loved Barcelona, and made us want to come back again!
author: Maureen_S

title: Excellent wheelchair tour
text: Maria was a personable tour guide who was very attentive to the needs of our older wheelchair user and 13 month old. The tour gave us a thorough tour of Barcelona and discussions of architecture, history and lifestyle. We also can’t say enough about our kind and knowledgeable driver, a local native. Their understanding of disability needs is top notch.
author: GlobeTrotting407333

title: Nice  tour of Barcelona
text: Great experience! Our driver and our tour guide, Maria took an excellent care of every detail. They picked us up at our hotel and showed us the sites of Barcelona accompanied by an engaging commentary and historic details. The van was comfortably air conditioned and my husband and I had a great time touring the Montjuic, Barceloneta, and best of all, Sagrada Família which was truly spectacular. My husband uses a mobility scooter and our guides helped us during the tour but also provided useful advice and recommendations for the rest of our stay for places to visit and what to avoid.
author: Maia_M

title: Wonderful Experience !
text: Mari and Mariana (the driver) were excellent at their jobs. Mari was fun and enjoyed being a guide. Vivacious. The driver was very experienced. We enjoyed them and it seemed they enjoyed us.
author: Lynne_S

title: Superb experience’
text: This was our first wheelchair tour with Viator! Our guide, Maria was friendly,professional, and had a wealth of knowledge about Barcelona, its history and culture! My primary interest was the Sagrada Família church and she made sure that we spent plenty of our time there! I’m a retired teacher and she made sure to include the charming school that Gaudi provided for the children of his workers . This included a reconstruction of their classroom and photos of the students learning and playing which I enjoyed immensely! author: comedytours

title: Great accessible tour of Bardelona
text:
Carlos was amazing and met us right at the Princess term C on arrival. We really enjoyed his knowledge and he added some fun to his stories.
Did everything we asked for. We had a foldable wheelchair and scooter which went in the back of the taxi. Thanks very much Carlos for introducing Barcelona to us in our short 4 hour tour!!!
author: Cathryn_T

title: We could see absolutely everything even with surprise included. Very friendly from the first moment
text: The treatment we were given from before the tour was exceptional. The guide made sure we entered the sacred family without having tickets. It was something we didn’t expect at all and we appreciate it very much. The vehicle is well equipped and the driver helped us to fold the chair and get on and off. Very kind everyone
